name: Yuusha to Kimi ni Hanataba o
source:
The magic city Reifan is where thousands of years ago, a goddess saved the world from being taken over by the demon lord. The protagonist is an adventurer who travels around the world and he comes to Reifan. Along the way, he saves a female knight who was attacked by a monster. Before losing consciousness, she says “to the magic school in Reifan…”. Upon arriving at the school with her, the principal informs him that she is Princess Cynthia from the neighboring country, and that monsters have been threatening the area lately. He asks him to become friends with her so that she will not be worried. When he was leaving the room, a girl named Teana calls out to him and she gets him to stay at the Crystal Goddess Inn where she works.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
魔法都市雷凡是数千年前一位女神从魔王手中拯救世界的地方。主人公是一名周游世界的冒险者，来到雷凡途中救下一名遭魔物袭击的女骑士。失去意识前，她说：“去雷凡的魔法学校…”主人公把她带到学校后，校长告诉他，她是邻国的辛西娅公主，近来魔物一直威胁着这一地区。校长请他与公主成为朋友，免得她过于忧虑。主人公离开房间时，一名叫缇雅娜的少女叫住了他，并安排他入住自己工作的水晶女神旅馆。
